opportunities.title: SwiGLU forward/backward pairing: recompute silu(gate) in backward instead of saving it
opportunities.ops_summary: forward silu output write (saved for MulBackward) + backward read of the saved silu, 32 layers
opportunities.saving_basis: 32 x (234.9 MB forward write + 234.9 MB backward read) / 6921 GB/s = 2 x 1.0860 ms. Requires both fused forward (O-01) and fused backward (O-02). Cards that fold the forward into a GEMM (O-04) or the backward into the w2 dgrad epilogue (O-05) hide the corresponding half under the GEMM, so they capture 0.5.

opportunities.title: SwiGLU forward folded into an adjacent GEMM (w13 epilogue or w2 A-operand prologue)
opportunities.ops_summary: forward / layers.*.feed_forward.w13 mm (or .w2 mm) + the fused SwiGLU kernel of O-01
opportunities.saving_basis: Extra over O-01+O-03: the standalone fused kernel's ideal (read gate_up, write h) 32 x 704.6 MB / 6921 GB/s = 3.2579 ms disappears. w13 GEMM measured 28.35 ms (46.20-17.85; C-5925 implies 28.72) vs roofline 31.91 ms; epilogue bytes 1.24 GB/instance = 5.74 ms total, under the GEMM time. GEMM-epilogue/prologue rule: the fused kernel's ideal is max(bytes/HBM, min(flops/peak, measured GEMM)); the GEMM here measures below its bf16 roofline (low-entropy fake-PG data), and epilogue bytes fit under it, so the increment over the standalone fused glue kernel is that kernel's ideal time. Strict max(bytes, flops/peak) would give -0.30 ms for the w13 route (GEMM already beats the peak); the w2-prologue route has GEMM 16.23 ms vs 15.96 ideal.
opportunities.notes: w13 route needs paired gate/up columns (14336 apart) in one tile; w2 route needs an elementwise A-prologue and still owes h (and silu) to the backward. Alternatives: implement one.
